metadata.title: AI Tattoo Generator
metadata.description: See your tattoo before you ink. Upload a photo, describe your idea, and AI generates realistic tattoo previews on your body.
metadata.keywords: ai tattoo generator, tattoo preview, tattoo design, ai tattoo, tattoo before ink

sign.sign_up_description: Create an account for 3 free credits. Email verification is required; the bonus is awarded once per account.
sign.forgot_description: Enter your email to receive a password reset link.
sign.reset_link_sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
sign.reset_description: Choose a new password for your account.
sign.reset_success: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
sign.reset_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
sign.reset_failed: Unable to reset your password. Please try again.
sign.social_failed: Unable to sign in with Google. Please try again or use email and password.

funnel.verifyTitle: Verify your email to start creating
funnel.verifyDescription: Verify your email before uploading a photo or using credits. Existing balances stay with your account.
funnel.guestTitle: See the real results. Then make it yours.
funnel.guestDescription: Follow the complete workflow and explore real tattoo results generated with this website. Sign up when you are ready to use your own photo.
funnel.bonusExplanation: New accounts receive 3 credits once. Verify your email to use them. Each complete set costs 1 credit at 1K, 2 at 2K, or 3 at 4K.
funnel.noCreditsTitle: You have used all your credits
funnel.noCreditsDescription: Your results are still here to view and download. Buy a credit pack when you want to try another idea.
funnel.signupBenefit: Create an account for 3 free credits. Email verification is required; the bonus is awarded once per account.
funnel.trialBalance: One design + four body previews. 1K: 1 credit · 2K: 2 credits · 4K: 3 credits.
funnel.verifyPageDescription: Enter the six-digit code sent to your email to unlock personal generation.
funnel.verificationFailed: Unable to verify the email. Please check your code.
funnel.sendFailed: Unable to send the code. Please try again later.
funnel.oneTimeNote: Signing in again does not reset or refill your credits.
funnel.signupSuccess: Account created. Verify your email to use your 3 credits.

funnel.resolutionHelp: One tattoo design + four body previews at your chosen resolution. Higher resolutions may take longer.
funnel.resolutionInsufficientTitle: Not enough credits for this resolution
funnel.resolutionInsufficientDescription: This resolution needs {count} credits. Choose a lower resolution or buy more credits.
